definitions.gloss: primeval forest, virgin forest, old-growth forest
definitions.explanation: A forest that has grown naturally without significant human intervention, maintaining its original ecological state.

examples.japanese: {原生林|げんせいりん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手付|てつ}かず→手付かず：19324_tetsukazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原生林|げんせいりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Untouched primeval forest remains on this island.

examples.japanese: {原生林|げんせいりん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{希少|きしょう}→希少：12444_kishou⟧な⟦{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}→動植物：23782_doushokubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生息地|せいそくち}→生息地：09253_seisokuchi⟧になっている。
examples.english: Primeval forests serve as habitats for many rare plants and animals.

notes:
{原生林|げんせいりん} refers to a forest that has grown naturally without significant human intervention. A compound of {原生|げんせい} (primeval, original) + {林|りん} (forest).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {原生林|げんせいりん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect primeval forest
- {原生林|げんせいりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: primeval forest remains
- ⟦{手付|てつ}かず→手付かず：19324_tetsukazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原生林|げんせいりん}: untouched primeval forest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {原生林|げんせいりん}: primeval/virgin forest (never logged or significantly altered)
- {天然林|てんねんりん}: natural forest (grew naturally but may have some human impact)
- {人工林|じんこうりん}: planted forest, plantation
- {二次林|にじりん}: secondary forest (regrown after logging)

In Japan, notable {原生林|げんせいりん} include {白神山地|しらかみさんち} (⟦{世界遺産|せかいいさん}→世界遺産：04897_sekaiisan⟧, beech forest) and {屋久島|やくしま} (ancient cedar forest).
